q: Who reports the emissions of a plant run under a Mexican shelter or maquiladora arrangement?
title: Mexican shelter plants: who reports
short: It depends on the boundary rule each company uses. Under operational control, the foreign client that runs the production usually reports the plant's Scope 1 and 2, even if the shelter company is the legal importer and employer. The shelter reports its own offices and services. Agree it in writing so nothing is counted twice or missed.
audience: Foreign manufacturers operating in Mexico through shelter or IMMEX arrangements, and the shelter companies serving them

ul: GHG Protocol lets a company use equity share, financial control or operational control, applied consistently.
Under operational control, whoever introduces and runs the operating policies reports the plant.
The other party treats it as Scope 3 if relevant.

p: The client controls production, equipment and energy use, so it reports the plant. The shelter company reports its own administration, staff transport it runs, and other services.
Name who reports which emissions, who holds the bills and how data is shared each year.
